info.title: PG Management System API Documentation
info.description: Exhaustive, 100% complete API documentation for the StaySync PG Management System backend. Supports user authentication, dual JWT token rotation, geolocated PG discovery, room & bed management, tenant onboarding lifecycle, rent invoicing, staff payroll, expense tracking, reviews, and scheduled cron triggers. Set your Bearer Token to test authenticated routes.
